author: PeiZhuLai
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds `MCZllMesonPhotonFilter`, a HepMC-based generator filter for Drell-Yan
samples. It keeps events in which a photon from a light-meson decay could be
reconstructed as a prompt photon. HIG needs it for the central production of the
DY background samples of the HZ analysis.

An event passes if all of the following hold (default values):
- a stable photon with pT > 5 GeV comes from a  or  decay;
- the cluster seeded by the leading such photon, adding every stable photon within
  R < 0.1 of the cluster axis, has pT > 10 GeV;
- the leading ee or  pair has 75 < m < 105 GeV.

All values are configurable (`fillDescriptions`, cfi `mcZllMesonPhotonFilter_cfi`).
No existing code is changed.

#### PR validation:

- `scram b code-format` and `scram b code-checks` give no changes.
- 100k Pythia8 Z+jet  ee/ events (CP5, 13.6 TeV) were filtered with this module and
  with the private version used for our current samples, in the same job:
  12006 events pass both, 0 pass only one of them.
- Setting `minClusterPt = 0` raises the number of passing events to 20157, so the
  parameter is used.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backports to 12_4_X, 13_0_X and 14_0_X will follow, for the Run3Summer22,
Run3Summer23 and RunIII2024Summer24 campaigns.
title: Add MCZllMesonPhotonFilter to GeneratorInterface/GenFilters
